narration: Three vehicles, ONE giant mud pit — who makes it across?!
First up — the tiny yellow hatchback zooms in full speed… and immediately gets swallowed up like a bath toy! It just sits there, spinning its wheels, going absolutely nowhere!
Next — the chunky orange SUV rumbles up, looking super confident. It pushes in… makes it halfway… and then sloooowly sinks down, tilting sideways like a sleepy hippo. So close!
Last chance — the MASSIVE green monster truck revs its engine… BOOM!
Those giant tires chomp right through the mud — WHOOSH — it bounces up the other side and launches into the air, landing perfectly with a HUGE mud splash! The crowd goes wild!
The monster truck wins the mud pit! Tomorrow — a speedy blue rocket car, a giant purple dump truck, and a teeny tiny red go-kart take on a MEGA RAMP! Don't miss it!
